description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team. 
 
 
 Role Overview 
 We are hiring a Site Reliability Engineer to support the reliability, availability, and performance of our fintech platform.
 
 This is a hands‑on individual contributor role focused on execution and ownership. You will work closely with other senior engineers and an SRE SME, contributing directly to automation, infrastructure, and production stability.
 
 The ideal candidate is technically strong both in SRE principles and DevOps practices, comfortable owning systems end‑to‑end, and experienced in operating high‑availability, transaction‑heavy environments.
 
 Responsibilities 
 Design, implement, and maintain reliable and scalable infrastructure

 Write and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code, automation, and CI/CD pipelines

 Perform day‑to‑day production troubleshooting and performance tuning

 Improve monitoring, alerting, and observability

 Participate fully in on‑call rotations and production support

 Own assigned services, tools, or reliability initiatives

 Respond to production incidents using documented procedures

 Contribute to root cause analysis (RCA) and post‑incident actions

 Implement fixes and improvements to prevent recurrence

 Support reliability metrics such as SLOs, SLIs, and SLAs

 Work closely with fellow SREs, developers, and security teams

 Execute work aligned to operational priorities and technical debt reduction

 Continuously improve tooling, documentation, and operational processes

 Adopt and apply platform standards and best practices

 
 Your Profile 
 Minimum 3 years of experience in SRE, DevOps, or Infrastructure Engineering

 Strong hands‑on experience with:
 AWS cloud platforms

 Docker and Kubernetes

 Terraform or similar IaC tools

 Kafka experience (AWS MSK or Confluent)

 CI/CD tools

 
 Monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, ELK, Splunk)

 Python or Bash scripting

 Solid SQL skills and workload analysis experience

 Experience supporting production systems and participating in on‑call

 Understanding of distributed systems, networking, and security

 
 Nice‑to‑Have 
 Experience in 24/7 or high‑transaction production environments

 Cloud or platform‑related certifications

 Fintech or regulated systems exposure

 
 Work Arrangement 
 Hybrid: Onsite 4× per month (Makati City)

 Shift Options: 5:00 AM - 2:00 PM or 6:00 AM - 3:00 PM (Manila)

 Workdays: Either Mon – Fri | Tue – Sat

 
 #LI-KA2
 #LI-Hybrid
 
 We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective. 
 
 Use of AI in Hiring  
 As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.
